scientific_question: For the fixed canonical dense Euclidean-muP residual-tanh benchmark, are every currently identified proof-obligation defect and its measured amplification quantitatively too small to explain the finite-PDE versus ordered-target discrepancy?

scope.claim_supported_if_all_gates_pass: Overwhelming fixed-benchmark numerical evidence, conditional on the observed finite-grid contraction and geometric-tail envelopes.
claims_not_supported_by_finite_experimen: a literal proof of a supremum over infinite training time
uniformity over the parameter neighborhood U
falsification of the canonical-trajectory conjecture solely from a coherent off-manifold restart attack

norms.S_f_definition: Euclidean norm of the fixed target y
norms.S_G_definition: Frobenius norm of X^T X for the fixed orthonormal inputs
norms.secondary_metric: the same full-curve metric on initialization-subtracted output and Gram paths, normalized by the maximum P5/dense learned motion with a 0.05 floor
norms.pde_state_norm: sum_i wb_i (||delta B_i||_2^2+|delta a_i|^2) + N^-1 sum_l,i,r wb_i wf_r ||delta c_lir||_2^2, square rooted
norms.dense_coordinate_norm: n^-1||delta B||_F^2+n^-1||delta a||_2^2+L^-1 sum_l||delta W_l||_F^2, square rooted
norms.depth_interpolation: piecewise linear in normalized depth s on the common 1/16 grid
norms.curve_supremum_semantics: maximum on every saved time and common depth node; not a certified continuum supremum

error_ledger.reporting_rule: Report every simultaneous upper bound and their sum even if a component fails its allocation.
error_ledger.nuisance_resolution_rule: A nuisance upper bound must also be below one fifth of the lower confidence bound of the discrepancy it is invoked to explain.
error_ledger.bootstrap_unit: Use whole coupled Gaussian roots/scrambles, preserving every width/depth/path coordinate. Stage 2 additionally resamples the W-replica index within each selected outer B/a root, using one replica-index draw per selected outer-root occurrence jointly across every depth, checkpoint, and field.
error_ledger.bootstrap_calibration: Each look uses 5000 independent pilot draws only to fix component scales, followed by 20000 independent calibration draws. One absolute max-standardized statistic jointly covers both tails and every declared component. Its empirical critical is the smallest binomially guarded order statistic whose finite-calibration assurance is at least 1-0.001/13. Pilot and calibration streams are split deterministically from the frozen seed.
error_ledger.small_root_policy: Nonparametric root bootstrap is assumption-dependent rather than an exact finite-sample theorem. Four-root/scramble families in Stages 0, 2, 4, 5, and 6 remain operational diagnostics: they may trigger follow-up work or report a clear adverse diagnostic, but they do not support a nominal finite-sample coverage claim and no four-root-derived component may enter the additive ledger as certified.
error_ledger.multiplicity: Reserve data alpha 0.049 and bootstrap-calibration Monte-Carlo failure 0.001. Allocate data alpha 0.049/7 to Stages 0 through 6 by Bonferroni, so a one-look stage uses confidence 0.993. Stage 0 splits its data alpha equally across frozen Phase-A, Phase-B, and conditional-P70 looks, giving 0.9976666666666667 per look. Sequential Stages 1, 3, and 4, and the reserved Stage-5 trigger/extension decision, split their stage data alpha equally across two frozen looks, giving 0.9965 per look. At most 13 bootstrap calls are preallocated Monte-Carlo failure 0.001/13 each; unused look or calibration error is not recycled. Every look uses one two-sided absolute max-standardized family over all declared metrics, horizons, kinds, and gates. The resulting 0.95 target remains conditional on the stated bootstrap approximation and is not represented as exact finite-sample coverage.

stage_0_integrity_and_numerics.source_rule: The canonical dense and PDE scientific kernels are imported byte-for-byte and their hashes are bound in FROZEN_INPUTS.json.

P5_standard.semantics: This is the P=5 slice of the common predeclared P=70 quadrature master; there is no separate legacy order-3 route.

execution_inventory_summary.phase_A_primary_scrambles: For each active P, first run primary base_order=5,N=16,R=256,dt=0.02 at all four scramble seeds.
execution_inventory_summary.phase_B_unlock_rule: Unlock the paired upward refinements only if the Phase-A simultaneous primary-scramble QMC-dispersion upper bound is below the 0.005 PDE-numerics allocation and below one fifth of the simultaneous lower bound on the adjacent-P discrepancy.
execution_inventory_summary.phase_B_paired_upward_refinements: At all four primary scramble seeds, run base_order=6, N=32, R=512, dt=0.01, and the cofinal joint corner as five separately paired refinements.
execution_inventory_summary.joint_corner: At all four scramble seeds, run the power-of-two and preflight-feasible cofinal corner base_order=5,N=20,R=512,dt=0.01; R=384 is forbidden because the Sobol constructor requires a power of two.
execution_inventory_summary.seed0_downward_diagnostics: base_order=4 and R=128 at seed 20260723 only; these are diagnostic and do not replace any upward gate.
execution_inventory_summary.phase_B_after_phase_A_failure: expected absent and reported as a stopped conditional branch, not as a missing-inventory error

nested_ladder.extension_stability_rule: Every active level is built as a literal prefix of the same predeclared P=70 base and fast master. Rebuilding with P=70 may not change any P<=35 byte.

P70_conditional_extension.trigger: Run only if the resolved 5-to-15-to-35 generator defects contract at both successive steps and the amplified 15-to-35 defect is below its error allocation.

numerical_resolution.joint_corner: none; no conditional P70 joint refinement is declared
numerical_resolution.nuisance_combination_rule: Sum the four expanded one-axis corrections as a conservative empirical axis-sum. This is not a rigorous interaction or cofinal bound; without an executed joint corner the numerical gate remains UNRESOLVED and cannot authorize P70.
numerical_resolution.failure_semantics: Every declared one-axis refinement is required even for the scoped empirical diagnostic. A missing or memory-rejected job remains UNRESOLVED.

P70_conditional_extension.interpretation_if_not_triggered: No positive arbitrary-accuracy numerical trend is claimed. If triggered, any missing or memory-rejected member of the dedicated P70 numerical-resolution family leaves P=70 numerical resolution UNRESOLVED.
P70_conditional_extension.coordinate_rule: Every P=5,15,35,70 trajectory in a max_level=70 generator job uses the same member of this dedicated family, so the 15-to-35 and 35-to-70 generator-defect ratio is not confounded by quadrature or solver resolution.

execution_inventory.semantics: This exact sparse inventory is the only allowed Stage-0 execution set. The ladders above declare available coordinates, not their Cartesian product.

stage_0_integrity_and_numerics.gate: Phase A first estimates primary-scramble QMC dispersion at every active P. Phase B is unlocked only if its simultaneous upper bound is below the 0.005 PDE-numerics allocation and below one fifth of the simultaneous lower bound on the adjacent-P discrepancy. If unlocked, the same four scrambles must pair the primary curve with every upward M, N, R, dt, and cofinal-joint refinement; all simultaneous refinement bounds must meet the same allocation and nuisance rule. If Phase A fails, absent Phase-B jobs are an expected stopped branch, not a missing-inventory error. Seed-0 downward M/R runs are diagnostic only.

coupling.width: top-left prefixes of common standard-Gaussian arrays, rescaled by sigma_w/sqrt(n), with shared B and a prefixes

stage_1_ordered_target.depth_alignment_grid: For each coupled root, align every Gram path to the complete finest selected depth grid with max(L_grid)+1 normalized-depth nodes (65 for the full screen and 129 for the full positive grid); never reduce this to a fixed coarse 17-node grid.
stage_1_ordered_target.concentration_gate: At every fixed L and width, compute each root's distance from the leave-one-out ensemble center. Gate the RMS of those LOO distances, not an underpowered empirical q95: its fitted log-width slope must have simultaneous one-sided upper confidence bound below -0.25. Use RMS/sqrt(number of roots) for the ensemble-mean sampling bound. Report empirical maximum and q95 only as descriptive statistics.
stage_1_ordered_target.mean_correction_gate: At every fixed L, three paired mean width corrections give two successive norm ratios whose simultaneous upper confidence bounds are below one.
stage_1_ordered_target.depth_gate: The finest-width curve at each depth remains the center; its conditional width-tail radius is propagated as a norm ball into every adjacent-depth correction. No synthetic vector extrapolation is formed. The resulting three conservative corrections and two ratios obey the same upper-bound-below-one rule.
stage_1_ordered_target.tail_semantics: Any geometric remainder correction_last*r/(1-r) is a conditional norm-ball radius under continuation of the observed ratio envelope; norm contraction alone is never used to infer correction direction.
stage_1_ordered_target.screen_stop: Analyze the screen in a permanent screen-only simultaneous family using one half of the Stage-1 alpha. A simultaneous lower confidence bound at or above one for a successive correction ratio, or another clear screen failure, stops Stage 1 and makes any positive-tier archive a protocol violation that cannot erase the failure. A screen that is UNRESOLVED triggers the frozen positive grid, analyzed in the second half-alpha family.

global_master.width_coupling: For every outer root and W-replica index, all cells use literal prefixes of one fixed n_max=512,L_max=128 standard-Gaussian master: B[:n], a[:n], and W[:L_max,:n,:n], with sigma_w/sqrt(n) applied only after taking the prefix.
global_master.depth_coupling: Every coarse standard-Gaussian layer is the normalized consecutive-block sum of its finest L=128 layers. This is the literal recursive Haar coupling, and the same master is used across every declared width and depth.

stage_2_homogenization.candidate_innovation_definition: Two distinct empirical finite-P diagnostics use the same finite-width orthonormal Phi_P. The forward diagnostic is the nonlinear reconstruction residual phi(W H)-phi(W Phi_P Phi_P^T H); it is generally not orthogonal to Phi_P. The shared-transpose diagnostic is the exact row-projection residual (I-Phi_P Phi_P^T)W^T beta and is algebraically orthogonal to Phi_P.
stage_2_homogenization.candidate_identification_boundary: Both diagnostics use the realized dense H and beta, so neither is an independent evaluation of E[action | theta,w] and neither can certify the trained conditional/Onsager mean. Only the transpose residual has the algebraic projection-tail interpretation; the forward residual is a nonlinear reconstruction diagnostic.
stage_2_homogenization.archive_boundary: Each outer-root archive stores replica-level terminal hidden/input-adjoint fields and depth-averaged actions/residuals, the full L-by-L replica covariance summary, its L^-2 double sum, signed fixed-half off-diagonal bias-squared summaries by layer and after depth averaging, and exact global-master seeds and hashes. It never stores raw layer actions, projected actions, or layerwise residual tensors.
stage_2_homogenization.bias_estimator: Freeze the eight W replicas into halves {0,1,2,3} and {4,5,6,7}. The signed inner product of the two half-means estimates squared unconditional outer-root mean without diagonal variance contamination. For every stored replica-level depth average, the hierarchical bootstrap resamples separately within each fixed half and uses the same two replica-index draws jointly across every depth, width, checkpoint, and field for a selected outer-root occurrence. Stored by-layer signed summaries have no cross-depth pooling and are point diagnostics and audit crosschecks; their uncertainty is outer-root-only because layer tensors are intentionally not archived. The stored depth-average signed statistic is the L^-2 aggregate over every layer pair and belongs to the simultaneous inferential family. This does not hold the compressed state fixed.
stage_2_homogenization.covariance_estimator: Retain the full layer-by-layer covariance and its L^-2 double sum. The double sum is exactly the sample variance of the stored replica depth averages, so integrated-covariance slopes and their within-half hierarchical bootstrap require no raw layer tensor. The full covariance shape itself is a point diagnostic; only its integrated scalar enters the simultaneous inferential family.
stage_2_homogenization.model_free_gate: For every model-free field, the simultaneous one-sided variance-slope upper confidence bound must be below -0.5. A slope near -1 is a diagnostic target, not a required confidence-interval inclusion; faster decay is admissible.
stage_2_homogenization.coupled_width_diagnostic: At each width fit every declared depth slope. At L=128, report each scalar variance, integrated covariance, and signed bias-squared statistic at n=128,256,512 together with the paired adjacent-width corrections |S_256-S_128| and |S_512-S_256| and their simultaneous ratio bound. A ratio upper bound below one supports finite-width contraction of that statistic; lack of contraction leaves the homogenization stage unresolved. It does not identify the conditional/Onsager mean.
stage_2_homogenization.candidate_gate: The integrated centered finite-P diagnostic covariance should be O(1/L). Any nonzero high-P outer-root mean is a failure signal, but a small value leaves the actual conditional/shared-transpose mean gate UNRESOLVED unless a fixed-compressed-state conditional predictor is tested and mapped through observable amplification. Forward values are nonlinear reconstruction residuals; transpose values are orthogonal projection residuals.

failure_interpretation.variance_pass_high_P_bias_failure: finite-P diagnostic bias, consistent with wrong conditional/shared-transpose mean, truncation, or missing state; the present diagnostic does not distinguish them
failure_interpretation.high_P_pass_P5_fail: low-order truncation error rather than homogenization failure

stage_3_same_state_attack.basis_semantics: Every perturbation is constructed in the complement of the literal nested P=35 Hermite span and therefore preserves P=5 and P=15 automatically. Retained-coordinate defects are audited separately at all three levels. There is no P=5-only sufficiency claim and no separately optimized lower-P attack.
stage_3_same_state_attack.bundle_semantics: One job per (n,L,root) trains to the checkpoint once, constructs one frozen unit-direction family per attack kind, runs every declared amplitude to the maximum restart horizon, and records both horizon readouts on a shared path.
stage_3_same_state_attack.root_coupling: A root index determines one seed independent of (n,L). Every cell materializes from a fixed n_max=512,L_max=64 Gaussian master using width prefixes and consecutive-block Haar depth sums, so whole-root resampling jointly across cells is valid.

sequential_design.trigger_rule: Run the three confirmation cells only if at least one predeclared coherent amplitude/horizon gap at the screen has simultaneous lower confidence bound above 0.015 and every declared present-state constraint passes.
sequential_design.confirmation_rule: A structural warning requires at least one amplitude/horizon pair that triggered at the screen and whose simultaneous coherent-gap lower confidence bound also exceeds 0.015 in every confirmation cell, with every present-state constraint passing.
sequential_design.null_screen_interpretation: If no coherent screen gap has simultaneous lower confidence bound above 0.015, stop Stage 3. Report UNRESOLVED/no off-manifold counterexample; do not run the 24 confirmation jobs and do not interpret absence as sufficiency evidence.

stage_3_same_state_attack.independent_attack: At every layer use independently seeded P=35-invisible rank-one directions. The frozen unit directions are scaled by alpha, giving per-layer Frobenius norm alpha and entry RMS alpha/n.
stage_3_same_state_attack.coherent_attack: At every layer choose the top rank-one direction of the P=35-invisible projection of a fixed terminal dot-Gram linearized objective, orient all layer scores positively, then scale the frozen unit directions by alpha. This is exact only for each layer's declared local linearized objective, not a global optimizer of the nonlinear restarted trajectory.
stage_3_same_state_attack.manifold_status: Both independent and coherent attacks are off-manifold restart stresses; reachability from canonical initialization is not asserted.
stage_3_same_state_attack.primary_falsification_diagnostic: The coherent continuation gap at P=35. Its construction is per-layer structured/local and is not a global optimizer of the nonlinear restart. A width/depth-stable lower confidence bound above the amplified-closure allocation is strong evidence that the compressed state misses causal information, subject to the explicit off-manifold/reachability caveat.
stage_3_same_state_attack.gate: Stage 3 is a one-sided falsification diagnostic, not a positive sufficiency gate. A constraint-preserving, width/depth-stable coherent P=35 gap above the amplified-closure allocation is a structural warning; independent gaps are corroborating sensitivity evidence.
stage_3_same_state_attack.interpretation: A persistent gap cannot be dismissed as P=5 truncation because P=35 coordinates are preserved, but neither attack alone falsifies the canonical-trajectory conjecture without a reachability argument. If no persistent gap is found, the state-sufficiency obligation remains UNRESOLVED; absence of an off-manifold counterexample is never a sufficiency certificate.

residuals.back: Pi_P F_Q(Y_Q)-F_P(Pi_P Y_Q) in the weighted state norm
residuals.lift_low: Pi_P F_Q(iota_P Y_P)-F_P(Y_P) in the weighted state norm. This is a genuine low-mode generator defect, not an algebraic prefix identity; validate shape/finiteness and gate its contraction.
residuals.out: (I-iota_P Pi_P)F_Q(iota_P Y_P) in the weighted state norm
residuals.full_high_outgoing_diagnostic: (I-iota_P Pi_P)F_Q(Y_Q), reported separately and never substituted for the lift-low outgoing residual
residuals.observable: instantaneous f and all-depth Gram derivative defects
residuals.integrated: trapezoidal integral of the residual norm over [0,2]

numerical_resolution.nuisance_combination_rule: Use the expanded direct primary-to-joint correction as the combined structural nuisance bound. The four one-axis corrections remain diagnostics and are not added to the joint correction.
numerical_resolution.failure_semantics: A declared refinement, including the upward base_order=6 (M=1296) check, that fails the frozen memory preflight remains UNRESOLVED and is never silently omitted.

basis_diagnostics.POD_semantics: data-dependent learned-coefficient POD diagnostic, never a confirmatory route

stage_4_generator_consistency.gate: The lift-low inconsistency, lift-low outgoing residuals, back residuals, normalized observable generator defects, and shadow errors themselves must first be stable under the four declared one-axis Stage-4 refinements and the active-only cofinal joint refinement base_order=6,N=12,R=256,dt=0.01,seed=20260723 from primary (M=625,N=8,R=128,dt=0.02); Stage-0 curve Cauchy checks and the downward M=625-to-256 diagnostic are not substitutes. The expanded direct primary-to-joint correction is the combined structural nuisance bound and the one-axis corrections remain diagnostics. The resolved quantities must contract from 5-to-15 to 15-to-35 before Stage 5 may authorize the conditional P70 extension and test further 35-to-70 contraction.
stage_4_generator_consistency.failure_interpretation: Noncontracting high-to-low feedback rejects the pure Hermite convergence evidence at the tested levels and triggers a response-enriched repair branch.

time_grids.rule: The refined grid adds every interval midpoint to the primary grid through the fixed horizon. Residual snapshots, impulse source times, observation times, and the trapezoidal residual integral use the selected grid.

numerical_resolution.nuisance_combination_rule: Use the expanded direct primary-to-joint correction as the combined structural nuisance bound. The four one-axis corrections remain diagnostics and are not added to the joint correction.
numerical_resolution.failure_semantics: A declared refinement, including the upward base_order=6 (M=1296) check, that fails the frozen memory preflight remains UNRESOLVED and is never silently omitted.

conditional_P70_extension.trigger: Run only when the frozen base-only Stage-4 state is TRIGGER_READY and the numerically resolved active P=15 from Q=35 amplified bound is below its allocation. Authorization is decided without inspecting any P=70 archive and unused alpha is not recycled.
conditional_P70_extension.numerical_gate: Analyze all eight dedicated P70 numerical configurations on both Stage-5 time grids. Report the P35-from-P70 amplified quantity A35 and its ratio to active A15. Because the dedicated P70 family has no cofinal joint corner, its numerical resolution remains UNRESOLVED and neither A35 nor a geometric A35/(1-r) candidate may enter the error ledger.
conditional_P70_extension.interpretation: This measures only the next P=35 from Q=70 closure step on the finite residual dictionary. It does not establish P-to-infinity convergence or a full-state stability theorem.

stage_5_amplification.forcing_space: for each preregistered low level P in {5,15}, the orthonormal span of measured P-from-35 projected back-residual snapshots
stage_5_amplification.primary_gain: exact finite residual-subspace group-L1(time)/L2(direction)-to-Linf(observable) impulse gain: the maximum response-matrix spectral norm over declared source times, sink times, and normalized output/Gram blocks
stage_5_amplification.full_state_gain: diagnostic only; absence of a full-state adjoint certificate is reported explicitly. The implemented certificate is scoped to the finite P<=35 residual dictionary and does not certify a conditional P35-from-P70 residual.
stage_5_amplification.symmetric_nonlinear_amplitude_semantics: For each listed positive magnitude, integrate both plus and minus impulses; assess the centered response, each one-sided response, and the plus/minus symmetry defect.
stage_5_amplification.gate: For each low-to-35 residual pair, the measured residual integral, finite group-L1/L2 gain, and amplified product must first be stable under the four declared one-axis Stage-5 refinements and the active-only cofinal joint refinement base_order=6,N=12,R=256,dt=0.01,seed=20260723 from primary (M=625,N=8,R=128,dt=0.02); every compared low/high pair uses one common configuration. The expanded direct primary-to-joint correction is the combined structural nuisance bound and the one-axis corrections remain diagnostics. Stage-0 curve Cauchy checks are not substitutes. The simultaneous upper bound on the resolved amplified product, plus residual-basis reconstruction and source-time discretization bounds, must be below the amplified-closure allocation. The current nonlinear impulse experiment is diagnostic rather than a certified worst-direction nonlinear remainder, so a favorable finite-dictionary result remains scoped rather than a full stability theorem.
stage_5_amplification.ledger_scope: The active P5-from-P35 and P15-from-P35 products are contraction-trend and conditional-P70 trigger measurements only. The conditional P35-from-P70 look reports A35 and its ratio r to active A15. A candidate geometric P35-to-infinity bound A35/(1-r) exists only when a simultaneous upper bound has r_upper<1 and conditional numerical resolution is certified. The declared P70 family has no cofinal joint corner, so its current result remains UNRESOLVED and emits no amplified-closure ledger bound.
stage_5_amplification.non_double_counting_rule: The error ledger uses the low projected back residual; outgoing and back residuals are not added when they describe the same projection error.

stage_6_all_time_tail.execution_trigger: Run Stage 6 only after a fresh frozen analysis reports finite_horizon_identification gate status PASS; a FAIL or UNRESOLVED finite-time identification gate does not authorize all-time tail execution.

dense_diagnostic.scope: finite dense consistency diagnostic only; the ordered-limit gate is Stage 1

stage_6_all_time_tail.geometric_gate: The training-time-tail allocation begins after the active horizon T=2. Sum the simultaneous upper bounds for every measured post-active block (2,4],...,(64,128], then add q*A_last/(1-q) for the conditional future strictly beyond 128, where q is the simultaneous upper envelope from at least three consecutive late-block ratios. Apply the analogous accounting to the finite dense diagnostic through 32, but never treat that finite-width/depth diagnostic as an ordered-limit certificate. State arclength is reported separately and may enter the observable ledger only after multiplication by a verified late-time state-to-observable gain.
stage_6_all_time_tail.flat_floor_rule: The numerical floor is the simultaneous upper bound from a preregistered late-block dt-halving restart (and, for the PDE, the available N/R refinement). If block variation reaches that floor, later ratios are floor-censored rather than formed from two near-zero numbers.
stage_6_all_time_tail.interpretation: Without the geometric envelope or a separately verified trapping tube, t=128 remains finite-horizon evidence and no literal infinite-time claim is made.

sequential_stop_rules: Do not interpret dense/PDE gaps until Stage 0 numerical gates pass.
A clear ordered-scaling failure stops identification of the target but later structural diagnostics may run and are labeled diagnostic.
A model-free homogenization failure stops the pure homogenized PDE claim.
Do not compute an amplification certificate until a resolved generator residual exists.
Do not trigger P70 unless the resolved 5-to-15-to-35 defects contract twice.
No failed or unresolved preregistered gate may be converted to a pass by an unplanned refinement.
